articles.title: Why a new SEC plan could ease a legal headache for tokenized securities
articles.snippet: The SEC's new proposal to overhaul transfer-agent rules could eliminate duplicate offchain shareholder records, reducing reconciliation costs and legal uncertainty for tokenized securities.

articles.title: OKX brings OpenAI and Anthropic bets to Europe as pre-IPO trading grows
articles.snippet: The exchange is offering up to 10x leverage on private-company valuations alongside 100 tokenized stocks and ETFs.

articles.title: Bitcoin Bancorp snaps up thousands of defunct Bitcoin Depot ATMs for $620,000
articles.snippet: Just over a quarter of Bitcoin Depot’s more than 9,200 kiosks have been sold for less than $1 million, court records show.

articles.title: Crypto exchange giant Bybit to offer European ‘super-app’ with stocks, derivatives
articles.snippet: Bybit has an electronic money institution license in Austria and is about to snag a MiFID license too, CEO Ben Zhou told Coindesk.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin slumps as oil and bond yields surge to new highs
articles.snippet: The ECB hiked rates earlier Thursday, and U.S. core PPI was softer than expected, but still running hot.
